html:
Here is a poem from General George S Patton that embodies the spirit of one of my semi-dark main characters, Jack “The Ripper” Gregory:

Through A Glass Darkly

Best,

Richard

comments.author: aumbrieux
comments.html: Gen. George S. Patton, Jr. was a very wise man, he knew something that most men do not. Thank you.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html: Yes. As an aside, I got to meet General of the Army Bradley in 1980 and had a chance to ask him how accurate he thought the movie Patton was. He said he was a consultant on the film and it was exactly how he remembered George.
